subject.title: Feature Request: cron.defaults.delivery config for default delivery target

question: Should `cron.defaults.delivery` be copied into newly created jobs, or dynamically inherited on every run by jobs that omit delivery routing?
rationale: This determines whether a global config edit can silently change recipients for existing unattended jobs; source evidence cannot decide that security and upgrade contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Materialize on creation
options.body: Copy the configured route into new jobs so recipients remain explicit, inspectable, and stable across later config changes.

options.title: Inherit at runtime
options.body: Resolve omitted routes from current global config on every run, accepting that existing jobs can be retargeted without editing their records.

options.title: Keep routes job-local
options.body: Avoid a global recipient and reduce repetition through CLI and Control UI presets that persist explicit per-job delivery.

recommendation.title: Materialize on creation
recommendation.body: Copy the configured route into new jobs so recipients remain explicit, inspectable, and stable across later config changes.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the centralized create-time default, has the broadest recent cron/config history, and already participated in this issue's product triage.
